renovationEvidence.title: Eckart Hall First Floor Remodel
renovationEvidence.finding: Official report describes remodeling the northeast part of the first floor and adding a restroom. This establishes a later alteration risk for older first-floor drawings. It does not establish which current classroom boundaries changed.

renovationEvidence.verification: architect project text; image inventory checked separately by root
renovationEvidence.finding: Architect lists renovation phases in 2012, 2014 and 2017, including first-floor offices and second-floor teaching/study rooms. Public image inventory found Phase I/II/III photographs; no numbered plan was obtained.
